If demons created the world, this is what it would look like.}} [[The Foundry of Failed Creations]] is a section within the [[Domain of Anguish]]. Before [[Abaddon]] regained power and his forces broke free, it was used as a [[Margonite]] prison operated by the [[Forgotten]], holding particularly troublesome prisoners. [[The Fury]] was among them and, upon its release, it sundered and rearranged the prison into its now twisted form. The Fury had since gathered other followers of [[Dhuum]] to serve Abaddon until his death, and then hoped to gain [[Mallyx the Unyielding]]'s favor. Here, The Fury oversees the Foundry, converting it into a prison for Forgotten as well as a staging area to assault [[Tyria (world)|the mortal realm]], having been waiting for the [[Door of Komalie]]'s opening. It also oversees the creation of the [[Titan]]s that are formed there. {{TOCright}} ==Bounty== *[[Whispers Informant]] (outside the entrance gate) **[[Anguish Hunt]] ==Quests available== *[[Captain
